:::{#def-decidable}
#### Decidable problem

A [decision problem](p-and-np.qmd#def-decision-problem) $L$ is **decidable**
if some [Turing machine](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine)
[decides](models-of-computation.qmd#def-tm-computes) it:
the machine [halts](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine) on every input $x$,
with [output](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine) $1$ if $x \in L$
and $0$ if $x \notin L$.
A problem that no Turing machine decides is *undecidable*
[@arora2009computational, section 1.5].

:::
